name: @arena/api-read
description: The auth-gated read API boundary for Arena (Work Order B005; issue #71): the protocol-level HTTP-shaped read surface over the canonical read-model service. handleReadRequest authenticates FIRST through the B004 AuthService (fail closed: unauthenticated/expired/revoked/tampered → typed auth error envelope; anonymous reads are NOT representable), then scopes EVERY read to the tenant of the validated session context — the tenant NEVER comes from the request payload. Success envelopes echo the request kind and carry the canonical read results with source version, provenance and read-at; error envelopes use the house typed-error code vocabulary (READ_MODEL_* + AUTH_* codes). Versioned contract surface per spec/service-boundaries.md, consumed by B006/B007 UI wiring. Read-only: no write path exists on this boundary.
